title: feat(console): a greyed action says the reason its author declared
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBAQyBVaDQuUj1ZDR9GVydAG)_

Fixes #26619 — the console half. The spec half, `ActionSchema.disabledReason`, landed in #26786.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: #26790

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 置灰的动作按钮现在显示作者写的 `disabledReason`（悬停提示、读屏描述、菜单项第二行），没写或写了空白时仍显示「对此记录不可用」。覆盖记录页头（含 ⋯ 溢出菜单）、记录区块按钮栏、声明动作栏，以及 `action:button` / `action:icon` / `action:group` / `action:menu` 四个渲染器。原因文案走和动作其他文案相同的翻译路径：先取翻译包 `objects.对象._actions.动作.disabledReason`，再取作者的内联多语言映射，最后取作者原文。
- **为什么改：** 裁决 A（6442737825）的第二步。规格已在 #26786 落地，这个 PR 让控制台真正读它，hotclm 的送审 / 发起签署 / 生效能说清缺什么。
- **风险与回滚：** 不写这个键的动作显示不变。只有声明的 `disabled` 判断为真时才显示原因；动作执行中、宿主禁用的按钮仍不给原因。纯展示，不参与服务端准入。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useActionTextLocalizer.ts`（解析原因文案），`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/disabled-reason.tsx`（四个渲染器的共用钩子），`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`（存活账本改为 live）。
- **两分钟验证：** `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-disabled-reason-26619.test.tsx`，预期全部通过：写了原因显示原因，中文环境取内联映射的中文，不写时仍是默认句。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The readers.** While an action's DECLARED `disabled` predicate is TRUE, each surface shows its declared reason where it showed `actions.notAvailableForRecord`. That generic sentence stays the answer when the action declares none, or a blank one. The surfaces where nothing earns a reason are unchanged: a button greyed while its own action runs, the host's forwarded `disabled`, the host's Edit / Delete, and the legacy `enabled` leg.

- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx#disabledReasonFor`: the record header, inline and in the ⋯ overflow.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-quick-actions.tsx` (`QuickActionButton`): the record section bar.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` (`DeclaredActionButton`): the declared actions bar, button and override-menu item. The reason comes off the same localized copy as the label.
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/disabled-reason.tsx#useDisabledReason`: the four `action:*` renderers. The hook takes the declared reason as a second argument, and `action-button.tsx`, `action-icon.tsx`, `action-group.tsx` (inline and dropdown) and `action-menu.tsx` pass it.

**Translation.** The reason is an `I18nLabel` and is resolved like the action's other copy:

- `useObjectLabel` (`@object-ui/i18n`) gains `actionDisabledReason(objectName, actionName, fallback?)`, the `actionSuffixes` pattern: `objects.<o>._actions.<a>.disabledReason`, or `globalActions.<a>.disabledReason` with no key object. It reads the same two addresses `translateAction` and `os i18n extract` use.
- `useActionTextLocalizer` (`@object-ui/react`) collapses a declared reason's locale map to the active language and asks the bundle, but only when the action declares the key. That is the `confirmText` rule: a bundle cannot give a reason to an action whose author wrote none, so that action keeps the default. The record header, the section bar and the declared actions bar already run their actions through it.
- The four `action:*` renderers read the action as authored (they do not localize `label` through the bundle either), so the inline locale map is the translation they honour. `useDisabledReason` collapses it with `pickLocalized`.

**Types.** `UIActionSchema.disabledReason` (`@object-ui/types`), derived from the spec (`SpecAction['disabledReason']`), beside `disabled`.

**Spec side.**

- `packages/spec/liveness/action.json` `disabledReason`: `planned` → `live`, `evidenceScope: in-repo`, with the readers above as evidence. `authorWarn` and `authorHint` are dropped in the same edit, so a warned `live` row cannot red `check:liveness`. `liveness/state-counts/action.md` was regenerated.
- `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`: the #26619 block becomes a silence pin. The key is authored beside a property that still warns (`object.externalSharingModel`, `dead`) in the same call, so the silence is a reading. The block also asserts the shipped row is `live`, carries no warning, and cites `containers.tsx#disabledReasonFor`.
- The two `.describe()` texts (`action.zod.ts`, `translation.zod.ts`) and `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` no longer say that nothing shows the key. Four `content/docs/references/**` pages were regenerated by `check:generated --fix`.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/26619-console-disabled-reason.md`, every moved package at `patch`: `Metadata-protocol: none`, because nothing an author can write changes (AGENTS.md step 3). `@objectstack/lint` changes a test only.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useActionTextLocalizer.disabledReason-26619.test.tsx` (6): authored string, bundle outranks authored, locale map collapsed (zh), the `globalActions` address, no key added when the action declares none even with a bundle entry, a nameless action's map collapsed.
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-disabled-reason-26619.test.tsx`: for the three button renderings, the declared string as description and tooltip, the zh map, the default (en and zh), a blank map value falling back to the default, and the predicate-false control. For the two menu renderings, the declared second line, the default, and the control.
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-disabledReason-26619.test.tsx`: inline, overflow, the zh bundle outranking the authored text, the default, and the control.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-quick-actions.disabledReason-26619.test.tsx` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.disabledReason-26619.test.tsx`: the declared string, the zh bundle, the default, and the control.
- The `-11811` / `-11839` sibling suites, which pin the mechanics and the no-reason controls, pass unchanged.

- Head `d96cc5bbb` (`f6a479a30` plus the i18n pin), branch restarted from `main` at `aeb9cf0dd`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 735 passed (735), Tests 22041 passed, 1 todo.

The one failure was a pin that moves with the new resolver: `useObjectLabel-identity-5564.test.tsx` counts `useObjectLabel`'s members (27 → 28). It is updated in `d96cc5bbb` and passes (5/5).
- `ui/packages/core` was not run locally. On `main`, its `actionKeys.pin.test.ts` reds on the new spec key (SPEC_ACTION_KEYS lacks `disabledReason`). The seat's hotfix #26859 fixes that, and this branch takes it by a `main` merge once it lands. This PR does not add the row.
- eslint over the 17 changed ui files: 0 errors (warnings are pre-existing `no-explicit-any`).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The `action:*` renderers honour the inline map, not the bundle.** They render `label` as authored too. Giving them a bundle lookup would also need a key object they do not carry, and that is a wider change than this card. A registered action that reaches them through a surface that localizes (the record header, the section bar, the declared actions bar) already arrives with the bundle's sentence.
- **A blank reason falls back to the default** on every surface, including a locale map whose value for the active language is whitespace. The spec refuses a blank string but not a blank map value (#26786's acceptance note).

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint over the 17 changed ui files: 0 errors.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch restarted from `main` after #26786 merged, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
